audit.why: You own levels 2-6 against a 255-range, dashless stacker and lose the two-item lane; that matches the kit and the 46.7% win rate.
audit.corrected: Read stands; Wither's cooldown was the missing anchor for 'bait it, then all-in'.

audit.whatIsWrong: The two-item spike blames 'size/lifesteal' without naming what Fury of the Sands actually gives him.
audit.why: Fury of the Sands (R, 120/100/80s) grants bonus health, extra attack range, bonus armour AND magic resistance, and shortens Siphoning Strike's cooldown — the attack-range gain is why kiting a low Nasus fails, and the resists are why lethality stops working.
audit.corrected: Two items: Fury of the Sands adds health, attack range, armour and MR and speeds up his Q — it is why your kite and your lethality both stop working.

audit.whatIsWrong: Wither has no cooldown attached and Spirit Fire's armour shred is only mentioned in passing.
audit.why: Wither is 15/14/13/12/11s at 700 range — longer than your Heroic Swing (18/16.5/15/13.5/12s) at rank 1, so 'bait it then commit' needs the number. Spirit Fire (12s, 650 range) reduces the armour of anyone standing on it, and Siphoning Strike is an auto-attack reset, so his burst arrives on the auto wind-up, not the cast.
audit.corrected: Wither is 15s at rank 1 — commit inside its downtime; step off Spirit Fire's zone since it strips your armour; his Q is an auto-reset, so read the wind-up.

edits.after: Youmuu's lethality lets Avengerang into E-then-R burst him before Sheen and stacks come online, but if Wither (15s) lands first the trade flips.

edits.before: Levels 1-2 are quiet — you only have Q and your passive shot, and Nasus just wants to AFK-farm Siphoning Strike, so don't over-commit at 1 against his wither. Once your passive second shot is online, abuse it: throw Avengerang for the chip and the move speed on hit, weave your bonus shots, and most importantly stand on his Q last-hits so he can't stack for free. The one thing that punishes you is his wither — if he walks up and slows your move and attack speed, you eat a stacked Q, so hold your spacing and never trade inside wither range without Heroic Swing up to escape.
edits.after: Levels 1-2 are quiet — you only have Q and your passive shot, and Nasus just wants to AFK-farm Siphoning Strike, so don't over-commit at 1 against Wither. Once your passive second shot is online, abuse it: throw Avengerang for the chip and the move speed on hit, weave your bonus shots, and stand on his Q last-hits so he can't stack for free. The one thing that punishes you is Wither (15s at rank 1) — if he slows your move and attack speed you eat a stacked Q, and since that Q is an auto-reset the burst lands on the wind-up. Never trade inside 700 range without Heroic Swing up.

edits.before: This is your window — levels 4-6 are your strongest stage versus a slow, dashless stacker. Heroic Swing gives you a hook-and-swing poke and an escape, so swing off terrain, fire on him, and jump off before he can wither you. Keep Avengerang chunking him every time he steps up to last-hit. At 6, Comeuppance executes him from range once he's low and any takedown resets your swing to a 0.5s cooldown — but respect that wither flips any trade where he catches you, so bait it out, then all-in once it's on cooldown.
edits.after: This is your window — levels 4-6 are your strongest stage versus a slow, dashless stacker. Heroic Swing gives you a hook-and-swing poke and an escape, so swing off terrain, fire on him, and jump off before Wither lands. Keep Avengerang chunking him every time he steps up, and step off Spirit Fire's patch — it strips your armour while you stand in it. At 6, Comeuppance executes him from range and any takedown resets your swing to 0.5s — bait Wither's 15 seconds out, then all-in on its downtime.

notes: 'Going Rogue' in the packet's suspectNames is a false positive — it is the correct name for Akshan's W. Spirit Fire's armour reduction and Fury of the Sands' attack-range gain were both absent; the range gain is the specific reason a low Nasus still reaches you.
